messages.en: The lorry's here, right outside the house. Shall we start moving the stuff now?
Sure, just give me a sec. I'll grab the keys.

senses.en_definition: The outer part of something or the area outside it.
Beyond a particular scope, limit, or range, as of knowledge, control, responsibility, or expectation.

messages.en: I'm already waiting outside the shop. Where are you?
Inside, by the counter. Just come in—I can see you already.

senses.en_definition: A hole or opening in something through which something can pass or be seen.
A cavity or passage, especially a natural opening in the body.
A pit or hollow in the ground or a road surface.
(Colloquial) An opportunity or lead, especially for finding work or making money.

collocations.en: have a lead or an opportunity

messages.en: Watch out at the bend in front of that shop. There's a big pothole there—I nearly rode into it earlier.
Good thing you managed to dodge it in time. I'll slow down on my motorbike when I go past later.
That video you sent earlier is so funny! I've watched it three times already.
Right? Just seeing the look on his face makes me laugh.
